source.description: Dividend-adjusted closes of 14 sector/region/size/REIT equity ETFs, not OHLC or delisted stocks

method.walkForward: annual profile selection using only previously completed labeled calendar years
method.atrProxy: 1.8 x EMA14 absolute close move; no high/low
method.survivorship: 14 pre-specified long-lived equity ETFs (>=12 evaluated/session), not a delisting-complete stock universe
method.status: EXPLORATORY ETF PROXY, NOT AN AUDITED STOCKSCOUT SIGNAL

calibration.selection: historical yearwise score/forward-return correlation minus across-year variability

latestActual.interpretation: INDICATIVE ETF-proxy transfer; short REAL stock EOD history, no validated stock-level returns
